liquid_glass_renderer: glass shapes demo

A demo image from an open-source Flutter renderer for Liquid Glass: three clear glass shapes that bend a drawing grid at their rims.

Context

pub.dev describes the package as “the raw renderer for a liquid glass effect in Flutter”. Its first version, 0.1.1-dev.0, was published on June 13, 2025, four days after WWDC. pub.dev.

Wikipedia describes a wave of unofficial libraries after the announcement that approximate refraction and lensing with shaders, because platforms outside Apple have no native material. Wikipedia: Liquid Glass.

Observed

  • A beige-to-white gradient with a fine and a coarse grid of grey lines fills the frame.
  • Three glass shapes sit in a row: a rounded square, a circle, and a squircle with slightly flatter sides.
  • Inside each shape the grid lines stay straight in the middle but curve and compress in a band along the rim, as through a thick lens edge.
  • A thin bright highlight runs along the upper-left and lower-right rims. There is no fill color, no blur, no border, and no shadow.

Why it belongs

The image shows the one trait that separates the style from glassmorphism: the content under the glass is displaced, not blurred.

Borrow

Test a glass effect over a regular grid. A grid shows at once whether the edge refracts or only blurs.
